specification_compliance: Touch-point answer: the diff reaches no file outside the declared touch-point list except implicit ones. Files in the diff that are not named by path are covered by a listed bullet: frontend/e2e-components/projects.ts, spec-viewport.spec.ts and the target-menu-rows*.ts files fall under the e2e-components bullet; new test files (TargetMenu.collections.test.tsx, appTarget.collection.test.ts, the *.collectionTarget*.test.tsx files) sit under the test-harness bullet; docs/specs/app-target-collections.md and docs/specs/INDEX.md are implicit. So the list was complete for the diff as shown.

I1: TargetMenu.tsx targetRows() orders collections and Smart Collections by Intl.Collator(locale,{numeric:true}) on name, collection first on a tie, then by targetId; collection rows are usable:true; the default row has no icon (MenuRadioGroup renders an icon only when opt.icon !== undefined).
I2/I4: useVideoApp.ts and useReadingApp.ts parse the saved id with parseAppTargetId, wait only for the list the kind needs in lookingUp, and fall back to default without rewriting the saved id.
I6: TargetMenu with collections undefined yields NO_COLLECTIONS, so no collection row is listed.
I7: ManageTargetsDialog disables every toggle while pending and shows RetryButton when failed; onRetry calls only the failed list's retry.
I9: MenuRadioGroup change is additive; the icon span renders only when icon is defined.
I8: parseAppTargetId and collectionTargetId are as specified; resolveCollectionTarget calls assertBaseKinds, which throws on an empty base or one holding document.
potential_unspecified_behavior: The Manage dialog shows checked state for rows of a loaded list while the other list is pending, with the toggles disabled; the spec states this behaviour, so it is noted only.
regression_risks: TargetMenu now passes rows, not folders, to Rows; any caller relying on the old prop shape breaks at compile time only.
Same-name, same-kind rows fall back to a plain string comparison of targetId, not a locale-aware one; this matches the spec's wording.
test_coverage: New unit tests cover ordering, icons, shown-set rules, pending and failed lists, collection targets in Video and Reading requests (I3, I4, I6), the Discover cache under a collection target, and the appTarget helpers.

Real-browser cases exist only for the Video app (target-menu-rows.cases.ts runs on the Video fixture at 375px and 1280px); none for Reading's Target menu with icon rows, so Reading's icon row is verified only by reading the code.

Member-target tests (VideoApp.memberTarget*, ReadingApp.memberTarget) were not edited; they rely on installWireFetch's fallback returning [] for /collections, so they pass by default rather than by an explicit answer.
